{'text': 'iPhone Duo 上星期五開放預訂，其後旋即出現缺貨，訂單要延至 2027 年 1 月下旬才能交付。不過，多名用戶現時反映，他們訂單顯示的送貨日期比原先預計的更早。', 'paragraph_context': 'iPhone Duo became available for pre-order last Friday, then quickly became backordered into late January 2027. However, a number of users have started reporting that their orders now show earlier delivery dates than originally estimated.'}

{'text': '用戶表示 iPhone Duo 預訂送貨日期提前，以日本情況最為明顯', 'paragraph_context': 'Users report iPhone Duo pre-orders now set to arrive earlier, particularly in Japan'}

{'text': '如果你上星期訂咗一部 iPhone Duo，Apple 隨時可能已經將你的送貨日期提前——睇情況，尤其如果你係喺日本。', 'paragraph_context': 'If you ordered an iPhone Duo last week, there’s a chance Apple has just moved up your delivery date—especially, it seems, if you‘re in Japan.'}

{'text': '過去週末，日本多張 iPhone Duo 訂單的預計送貨日期都被提前，比 Apple 原先估計的更早。', 'paragraph_context': 'Over the weekend, a variety of iPhone Duo orders in Japan started getting pushed up to earlier dates than Apple originally estimated.'}

{'text': '例如，有用戶原本的 12 月送貨日期被提前到 10 月 23 日。', 'paragraph_context': 'For example, here’s a user whose December date got moved up to October 23.'}

{'text': '以下係 9to5Mac 的 Dylan McDonald 搜集到嘅一啲類似個案：', 'paragraph_context': 'Here’s a collection of similar reports found by 9to5Mac’s Dylan McDonald:'}

{'text': '目前仍未清楚呢個變動會唔會喺全球其他地方更廣泛推行。不過有部分訂單比預期更早到貨，都唔令人意外。', 'paragraph_context': 'It is unclear whether this change is going to start rolling out more broadly around the world. Though some orders arriving sooner than expected wouldn’t be surprising.'}

{'text': 'Apple 至今仍未就更新後嘅送貨日期作出回應。送貨預計時間得以改善，有機會其實係出錯，稍後可能會還原，希望最後唔係咁。', 'paragraph_context': 'Apple has yet to comment on the updated shipping dates. It’s possible the improved delivery estimates end up being errors that get reverted, but hopefully that’s not the case.'}

{'text': '目前新日期似乎只適用於直接向 Apple 下單嘅個案。我哋會繼續跟進呢宗新聞嘅最新發展。', 'paragraph_context': 'So far the new dates appear limited to orders directly from Apple. We’ll keep you posted on any new developments to the story.'}

{'text': '你嘅 iPhone Duo 送貨日期自從落訂以來有冇任何變動？歡迎喺留言區分享。', 'paragraph_context': 'Has your iPhone Duo delivery date changed at all since ordering? Let us know in the comments.'}
